svg.aria-label: About Ujjal Kumar Roy: senior software engineer at Frontier Semiconductor in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 4+ years shipping production JavaScript and TypeScript systems: national education payment portals for 26+ institutions, the Bangladesh judiciary's payment platform, a US fintech dashboard and, today, the frontend of a national-scale e-commerce platform. Work sits where product meets reliability: multi-gateway payment integration, SSO and government compliance, role-based access control and production debugging. Currently exploring agentic development and AI-integrated backends.

svg.text: · senior software engineer @ Frontier Semiconductor · Dhaka, Bangladesh
4+ years shipping production JavaScript and TypeScript systems.
National education payment portals for 26+ polytechnic institutions
A US fintech dashboard for 500+ active users
Today: the frontend of a national-scale e-commerce platform
Multi-gateway payments, SSO and government compliance, role-based access control
And the production debugging that keeps it all running
Systems that don't just respond, but decide
